package: nLab Framework 1.1.3 — Theme Configurator & Pattern Audit
purpose: Formaliser la règle de dominante configurable pour tous les templates et intégrer de nouveaux patterns génériques issus d'un nouvel audit du site de référence.
audit_findings: Navigation content must move from hard-coded JavaScript to project configuration.
Repository identity and public URLs must be provider/project configuration, never component constants.
DOM inference used by legacy foldable enhancement is useful for migration but declarative component metadata is preferred for generated nLab sites.
Version/cache identifiers should be centralized rather than repeated across loaders.
Semantic action icons should continue migrating from editorial emoji to the indexed SVG registry.
Floating window and toolbar state mechanics should remain shared primitives.
next_steps: Build a visual theme configurator demo using palette presets and free color input.
Add smoke tests for theme derivation and generic patterns.
